title: DECOUPLE EJS View Engine and Transition to Pure REST JSON API
content:
**What**: Removed legacy EJS view engine (`app.set('view engine')`), deleted `views/` directory and static assets (`public/css/`, `public/js/`), and refactored all routes to return standardized JSON payloads.
**Why**: Desacoples presentation layer from backend to support modern headless architecture with Astro v7+ frontend.
**Where**: `src/app.ts`, `routes/`, `package.json`, `views/`.
**Learned**: Converting HTML-rendering routes to pure JSON handlers simplifies API testing and aligns 100% with React Islands consumption.
